messages:
mikael: Heads up — payout to AcmeBio (tx_94a3f) was returned by ACH with reason 'Invalid routing number'. Bank noted they normalized the ABA to 9 digits by PREPENDING a 0, which made it mismatch our stored routing. Customer is blocked (waiting on reissue). Can someone triage?

julia (payments): Ugh. I remember we have CSV imports + UI entry. Any chance the routing got coerced to an int somewhere?

mikael: Payment payload we sent (sanitized):
```json
{
  "amount": 125000,
  "currency": "USD",
  "routing_number": 12345678,
  "account_number": "********1234"
}
```
Bank says correct ABA should have been 012345678. Looks like leading zero dropped.

nate (eng-ledger): That screams integer coercion. Our ledger parsers used to strip non-digits and cast to int in a few places for normalization. I'll search logs for tx_94a3f.

ops-bot: Retrieved event logs for tx_94a3f: incoming_payment.created -> processing -> payout.created -> payout.submitted. Last system note: "normalized_routing: 12345678".

nate (eng-ledger): Repro steps I ran locally: 1) import CSV with routing 012345678 2) internal normalized_routing became 12345678 3) we persisted that value and sent it to bank. Patch idea: treat routing as string, validate length, and pad left with '0' when sending.

julia (payments): Short term: can we reissue the payout manually with the leading zero? Customer prefers same-day. Who can do manual wire now?

karen (acct): I can reissue but need manager approval for >$50k. This was $1,250. I'll submit approval now.

ira (fraud): Also flagging — we should ensure any normalization doesn't change checksum. ABA has routing number checksum algorithm; if we drop digits we can produce invalid routing. Add ABA check before submit.

nate (eng-ledger): Agreed. Plan: (1) emergency hotfix to stop integer coercion in CSV and UI parsing (PR in progress) (2) add server-side padding: if numeric string length < 9, pad left with zeros before send (and log original) (3) add unit test for CSV -> normalized_routing path (4) add ABA checksum validation and reject on mismatch with clear error.

julia (payments): Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-4321 created; tagging ops for manual reissue. Customer notified they will receive a reissue in ~2 hours once manual step done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mikael: ETA for hotfix?

nate (eng-ledger): I'll cut a small PR now, aiming for deploy in next 45 minutes. Rolling deploy to avoid affecting throughput. If anyone sees other recent returns with code R01 or description referencing routing, please paste tx ids here.

ops-bot: Related returns in last 24h: tx_94a3f, tx_94b77, tx_94c10 (all with normalized_routing length 8).

julia (payments): I'll pause batch payouts for accounts created in last 48h until we confirm fix.

karen (acct): Reissue done for AcmeBio, customer notified. We'll refund bank fees and update billing.

mikael: Thanks. Nate, please add a migration or script to re-evaluate any persisted 8-digit routings and requeue as needed.

nate (eng-ledger): Yep — adding a one-off job to scan persisted payouts where routing length != 9 and ABA checksum fails. Will post PR and runbook.

ira (fraud): Also adding an alert to payments-monitoring: High rate of routing-normalization failures -> auto-pause new payout batches.

mikael: Good catch all. Followups: SUP-4321 for customer comms, ENG-9876 for codefix + tests, and runbook for manual reissue. Marking as high priority. :white_check_mark:
